definitions.gloss: formal clothes, festive attire, best clothes
definitions.explanation: Special clothing worn for celebrations, ceremonies, and other important occasions. Traditionally refers to kimono or other Japanese-style formal garments, but can also refer to any dressy outfit.

examples.japanese: {晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I dressed up and went out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{振袖|ふりそで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I wore a festive furisode kimono to the coming-of-age ceremony.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧、⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{微笑|ほほえ}ましい。
examples.english: The sight of children dressed in their festive attire visiting the shrine for Shichi-Go-San is heartwarming.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from ⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧ (hare), which refers to special, public, or ceremonial occasions in Japanese culture (as opposed to {褻|け}/ke, the everyday). Often refers to traditional Japanese formal wear such as ⟦{振袖|ふりそで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧, ⟦{紋付|もんつき}→紋付：06294_montsuki⟧⟦{袴|はかま}→袴：02245_hakama⟧, or other kimono. Also used more broadly for any best or dressy outfit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear formal/festive clothes
- {晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: the sight of someone in formal attire
- {晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: dressed in formal attire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正装|せいそう}→正装：16053_seisou⟧: formal dress (general, not limited to Japanese style)
- ⟦{礼服|れいふく}→礼服：18440_reifuku⟧: formal wear, ceremonial dress
